description: We are conducting a confidential search for a highly skilled and dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This pivotal leadership role involves overseeing all operational aspects, ensuring the delivery of exceptional patient care, maintaining regulatory compliance, and driving overall facility performance.The successful candidate will be a visionary leader with a proven track record in healthcare administration. You will be responsible for fostering a positive and productive environment for both residents and staff, implementing strategic initiatives, and ensuring the highest standards of quality and efficiency. This is an outstanding opportunity for an experienced LNHA to make a significant impact within a reputable organization.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Demonstrated leadership abilities with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.
